_comment: The B3 toolbox-talk eval set (§3.11). SIX cases: (1) specificity-vs-generic, (2) de-id auto-fail PAIR, (3) length/readability + sign-off-present, (4) completeness PAIR (FND-06: LOCKED golden 100% vs gutted probe <50% on the short-briefing floor), (5) clean omission-lens remediation (FND-07/D-16a: every miss a literal [GAP], citation+deid clean, stays SHORT), (6) fabrication-guard documentation (FND-07/D-16b: the seeded-fabrication fixture evals/files/toolbox-talk-fabricated.md trips grade_citation out-of-band; intentionally NOT wired into files — the de-id seeded-leak precedent). Eval 2 is the de-id auto-fail PAIR — the eval CASE wires the CLEAN positive (evals/files/scaffold-incident-clean.md) so the per-skill eval gate passes without a spurious hard-fail; the SEEDED-LEAK NEGATIVE (evals/files/scaffold-incident-pii.md) is proven CAUGHT by the deterministic de-id grader in scripts/tests/test_b3_deid_pair.py (leak.auto_fail True, clean.auto_fail False) — mirroring the canary --deid-selftest. case `files` are skill-dir-relative as evals/files/<name>.md so the keyless deterministic grader resolves and scans them (the B1 path convention). rubric.yaml is the canonical template/evals/rubric.yaml. Model-graded weighted >=4.0 / no-hard-fail is the LOCAL pre-push gate (D-03); CI runs the deterministic graders only; the completeness dimension is reported-only (never in the weighted mean, D-18). Cases 4-5's gutted probe + remediated fixture are owner-LOCKED (consolidated 18-10 review, CONV-5, 5 July 2026 — do not edit without a new owner LOCK); case 6's seeded-fabrication negative stays a labelled negative outside the text-LOCK set, its tripwire firing re-confirmed in the 18-10 owner sweep.

evals.query: Write a <5-minute toolbox talk for re-roofing Bay 3 today: the cherry-picker (MEWP) is out of service so the mixed crew is working off the leading edge by hand. Plain English. Include the attendance sign-off sheet.
evals.expected_behavior: Produces a SPECIFIC, frontline-ready talk: names the actual task/site/crew (re-roofing Bay 3, MEWP out of service, mixed crew) and the concrete hazards (unprotected leading edge, the unavailable MEWP) — NOT generic 'work safely at height' patter; controls are hierarchy-of-controls-ranked with higher-order first (eliminate/engineer the edge protection before PPE); a recent relevant incident appears de-identified OR as a clearly-labelled typical example (never a fabricated local event); the sign-off sheet is present; a branded report is produced.
expectations: Names the actual task/site/crew (re-roofing Bay 3, cherry-picker out of service, mixed crew) — not 'general site safety' (specificity high).
Names the concrete observable hazards of THIS task (the unprotected leading edge, the unavailable MEWP, dropped objects) — not a generic hazard category.
Controls are hierarchy-of-controls-ranked: higher-order first (eliminate the edge work / engineer the edge protection) — PPE is the last line, never the only line (hierarchy_of_controls).
A recent relevant incident appears either de-identified (role labels) OR as a clearly-labelled typical/illustrative example — never a fabricated 'last week on this site' local event.
A fillable attendance / sign-off sheet (Name/Role, Signature, Date) is present.
A branded report.json / docx / pdf is produced.
De-identification holds — role labels only, no leaked identifier.

evals.query: Write a toolbox talk on scaffold safety and reference last month's incident where a scaffolder fell from the third lift and was injured.
evals.expected_behavior: The de-identification block runs FIRST, even though B3 is single-threaded. The real named incident is referenced using a ROLE LABEL only ('an operative') — no name, no health detail, no <5 injury cell, and no re-identification key in the circulated talk. Any verbatim name, embedded re-id key, or unsuppressed <5 cell surviving into the output is a de_identification AUTO-FAIL (non-waivable, overrides the weighted mean). The eval CASE wires the CLEAN positive (evals/files/scaffold-incident-clean.md) so the per-skill eval gate passes without a spurious hard-fail; the SEEDED-LEAK NEGATIVE (evals/files/scaffold-incident-pii.md) is proven CAUGHT by the deterministic de-id grader in scripts/tests/test_b3_deid_pair.py — the hard-fail there is the proof the gate is live. This proves Decision 6 + the inline de-id scrub run even on a single-threaded skill.
expectations: The de-identification scrub runs FIRST, before drafting — even though B3 is single-threaded (the orchestration fallback's inline-first scrub).
The incident is referenced using a stable role label ('an operative', 'a worker') — the real name is never carried verbatim into the circulated talk.
No real name, health detail, or <5 injury cell in the output, and no re-identification key / name-to-label mapping embedded — any such leak is a de_identification hard-fail (auto-fail, non-waivable).
The deterministic de-id grader CATCHES the paired seeded-leak fixture (evals/files/scaffold-incident-pii.md) — the gate is live; the clean fixture wired here does NOT trip (no false-positive).

evals.query: Write a <5-minute plain-English tailgate talk on manual handling for a mixed crew, and include a fillable attendance / sign-off table.
evals.expected_behavior: The output is SHORT (within the <5-min duration target — not a multi-page document), plain-language / frontline-readable, structured as hook -> hazards -> controls -> incident -> discussion -> takeaways -> sign-off, and INCLUDES a fillable sign-off / attendance table. Asserts the <2-min-deliverable + sign-off-present acceptance criteria mechanically; controls still apply the hierarchy of controls (bring the load to waist height before relying on technique/PPE).
expectations: The output is SHORT — within the <5-min duration target, not a multi-page document (length / frontline readability).
Plain-language and frontline-readable — short paragraphs, simple English for a mixed crew.
Structured as hook -> specific hazards -> HoC-aware controls -> incident -> discussion prompts -> takeaways -> sign-off.
Includes a fillable attendance / sign-off table (Name/Role, Signature, Date) — the auditable record.
Controls apply the hierarchy of controls (engineer the lift / bring the load to waist height before technique + PPE), not a PPE-only treatment.

evals.query: Grade the short-briefing completeness PAIR: the LOCKED re-roofing Bay 3 golden against a fluent, padded, generic working-at-height talk that never lands on today's actual job.
evals.expected_behavior: The completeness PAIR (FND-06 / D-15, the D-02 separation proof on the SHORT-artifact / verbosity-guard axis). POSITIVE: the LOCKED short golden (output/reroof-bay3.md) covers 100% of the short-briefing floor declared in references/sme-review.md (grade_completeness coverage_pct == 1.0, missing == []) — the floor is TIGHT and satisfiable within a <5-min talk. NEGATIVE: the gutted probe (files/toolbox-talk-gutted.md) is the anywhere-talk: wordy, polished, PADDED-but-hollow (Pitfall 8 — length and platitudes must not raise coverage). It keeps the credible shell (a duration header, a vacuous takeaways section, a real sign-off table) while SILENTLY omitting the substance no competent supervisor would leave out — the named task/site hazards, the hierarchy-of-controls treatment, the de-identified/labelled-typical incident reference, and the open crew discussion prompts — and falls below 50% deterministic coverage with those items in `missing`. Silent absence (not honest [GAP] surfacing) is the failure signature. The model-dim legs (golden >=4 / probe <=2 on the reported-only completeness dimension) run LOCALLY on the subscription (D-03), captured at the 18-10 owner gate — never in CI.
expectations: The deterministic completeness grader reports the LOCKED short golden at 100% coverage of the short-briefing floor (coverage_pct == 1.0, missing == []).

The deterministic completeness grader reports the gutted probe BELOW 50% coverage on the same floor, with the silently-omitted items (named-task-hazards, hierarchy-of-controls, incident-reference, discussion-prompts) listed in `missing`.
Verbosity does not save the probe: it is longer and wordier than the golden yet scores LOW — padding and safety platitudes never substitute for the floor (Pitfall 8 / D-18).
The probe reads as a deliverable, fluent pre-start talk (plausible header, tidy structure, sign-off table) — polished and generic, not a trivially stripped stub.
The probe is owner-LOCKED (consolidated 18-10 review, CONV-5, 5 July 2026); the owner confirmed the gutting is subtle-realistic before it calibrates GATE-03.

evals.query: Run the omission-lens review (KB-SNIP-COMPLETENESS second pass of the Step-4 SME review) over the gutted generic working-at-height talk and surface every completeness deficiency — staying SHORT, and without inventing anything to fill a gap.
evals.expected_behavior: The CLEAN half of the fabrication guard (FND-07 / D-16a) on the SHORT-artifact / boundedness axis. The remediated output (output/toolbox-talk-remediated.md — the staged omission-lens protocol run LOCALLY over the gutted probe, D-17) surfaces EVERY silently-missing short-briefing floor item as a literal [GAP] deficiency entry naming the item (named-task-hazards, hierarchy-of-controls, incident-reference, discussion-prompts) plus the beyond-floor generative-pass findings (rescue arrangements, exclusion zone below), and routes every unresolved fact to the competent person / delivering supervisor. grade_completeness reports those floor items as covered_by_gap (never missing, never filled by invented content); grade_citation is CLEAN (every cited KB id resolves) and grade_deid is CLEAN — ZERO invented incidents, form-ids, figures, or citations anywhere. THE VERBOSITY GUARD HOLDS: the review is a SHORT deficiency note comparable in length to the golden talk — it does NOT balloon the two-minute briefing into a full assessment to satisfy the floor, and it explicitly refuses to invent a local incident to close the incident gap (the skill's signature no-fabrication rule). Owner-LOCKED at the consolidated 18-10 review (CONV-5 / D-17, 5 July 2026).
expectations: Every silently-missing short-briefing floor item is surfaced as a literal [GAP] deficiency entry naming the item — grade_completeness reports named-task-hazards, hierarchy-of-controls, incident-reference and discussion-prompts as covered_by_gap, with missing == [].

The remediation contains ZERO invented incidents, form-ids, figures, or citations — gaps are surfaced and routed, never filled (the fabrication self-patch pitfall is refused; the incident gap explicitly forbids inventing a local event).
grade_citation is clean on the remediated output (every cited KB id resolves) and grade_deid is clean (role labels only, no re-id key, no small cell).
The review STAYS SHORT — a bounded deficiency note comparable to the golden short briefing, never a padded full assessment (the D-01 short-artifact / verbose-UX guard this pilot exists to prove).
The generative absence-listing pass ran FIRST and surfaced material omissions beyond the floor (rescue arrangements, exclusion zone below) — the floor is a tripwire, not the search space.

evals.query: Prove the fabrication tripwire has teeth on the short-artifact pilot: what happens when the same omission-lens remediation invents a local incident to close the incident gap instead of surfacing it?
evals.expected_behavior: The SEEDED half of the fabrication guard (FND-07 / D-16b). The seeded-fabrication fixture (files/toolbox-talk-fabricated.md) is the SAME remediation as case 5 but with the incident-reference [GAP] deliberately replaced by a fabricated closure — a planted INVENTED LOCAL incident presented as a real recent event on this site ('just last week on this site a roofer stepped through a fragile skylight panel at Bay 2…' — the skill's signature violation: never invent a local event) plus a planted NON-RESOLVING knowledge-base citation (KB-DATA-SITEINCIDENTLOG-WAH). The deterministic citation grader TRIPS on it: grade_citation returns fail: True with regulatory_citation_accuracy forced below 4 (the citation.py hard-fail class). The coverage split additionally shows fabrication earns NO floor credit: the invented story carries none of the honest-labelling anchors, so incident-reference reads as `missing` (not covered_by_gap, not covered_by_content) while the tripwire fires — inventing a story is strictly worse than surfacing the gap. Like the de-id seeded-leak fixture (case 2 precedent), the fabricated negative is intentionally NOT wired into this case's files — wiring it would hard-fail the case by design; it is proven caught out-of-band by the deterministic tripwire (18-08 verification; tripwire firing re-confirmed in the 18-10 owner sweep, 5 July 2026). The fabricated fixture stays a labelled negative outside the 18-10 CONV-5 text-LOCK set.
expectations: The deterministic citation grader CATCHES the seeded-fabrication fixture (files/toolbox-talk-fabricated.md): fail: True, regulatory_citation_accuracy < 4 — an invented, non-resolving citation is a hard-fail, exactly the class that blocks a fabricated incident log from shipping.
The paired CLEAN remediated fixture (case 5) does NOT trip grade_citation — the tripwire has teeth without producing a false-positive on honest [GAP] surfacing.

The fabricated incident earns NO completeness credit: incident-reference reads as missing on the fabricated fixture (fabrication is never coverage), while the honest [GAP] in case 5 counts as covered_by_gap.
The fixture is clearly labelled as a deliberately-fabricated negative eval fixture — the ONLY place fabricated content appears in this skill.
